title: Exam MCQ
prompt:
The spec says: return true when the list contains **at least 3** matches. Which implementation is correct?

A. `count > 3`
B. `count >= 3`
C. `count >= 2`
D. `count == 3`

Print the letter, then your one-sentence justification.

tests.name: B exam
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "answer must start with the correct letter");
tests.hint: B. 'At least 3' is count >= 3. A is the near-miss clause (> 3); C answers 'at least 2'; D answers 'exactly 3'.
